notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market analytics SaaS focused on customer insights and in-app help. Started with Hosted API to validate UX; now wants Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Key asks: 1) tight 95th-p latency SLO for live chat (target 50-100ms RPC for short convos), 2) predictable token cost with reserve/burst pricing, 3) ability to pin model versions + canary rollouts, 4) strict audit logging and KMS-managed keys, 5) data residency in NA and option for on-prem connector for sensitive clients.

POC scope (what Redwood will deliver):
- Dedicated small pool (2 GPU equiv) deployed in customer's VPC for initial canary.
- Canary routing config: start at 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 48h windows if health gates pass.
- Model variants: primary = open-quantized-8b (latency optimized), fallback = open-quantized-4b (lower cost, compatible API), cold fallback = hosted-lower-tier model in eu-west region for overflow.
- Routing policy: policy-based routing by region + cost tiering; automatic fallback to compatible variant when latency > 250ms or error rate > 1.5% for 5m window.
- Rollback triggers: sustained 95p latency regression of +40% vs baseline, spike in server-side 5xx >1.5%, or semantic quality regression flagged by eval harness on prompt set. Rollback path: immediate traffic shift to previous model version + full incident runbook + postmortem.
- Observability: Console dashboards per-route, token-level cost, trace links, alert hooks to PagerDuty/Slack, and canary-specific charts.

POC metrics & targets:
- Latency: goal 95p <120ms (short convos), baseline from hosted = ~180ms.
- Throughput: ~80-150 qps expected for initial canary (burst to 300 qps with autoscale).
- Quality: reranking precision target +10% vs baseline on internal eval set.

Commercial notes:
- CumulusBridge prefers a two-phase commit: 3-month reserved pilot with option to convert to annual committed capacity. Asking for clearer overage and burst discounts. CFO wants modeled TCO vs hosted (3-tier compare).
- Negotiation points: minimum committed GPUs, burst capacity SLA, price protection for 12 months.

Security/legal:
- SOC2 Type II required, want subprocessor list and data flow diagram.
- KMS: prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) via HSM for encryption at rest.
- Retention: ability to set retention controls per-route and export audit logs for compliance.

Tech risks & open items:
- VPC peering and routing NAT constraints in their cloud account - infra ticket with Redwood needed.
- Need explicit test for SSO/SAML integration (IdP metadata provided).
- POC runbook needs one-step rollback automation (SE to supply script).

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We like the Console traceability — shows exactly where cost comes from." (Head of Prod)
- "If Dedicated brings 40% latency reduction and predictable costs, we can convert to annual commit." (CFO)

Next steps (short): finalize POC config, legal review of subprocessor appendix, pricing proposal for 3-month pilot + burst terms.
